Description: Insubrian and Boian broadsword warriors and druidic elders of the Po Valley and Alpine foothills. Preserving sacred forest traditions and sworn blood feuds against Roman colonial expansion, they fight bare-chested with towering stature, spiked limed hair, and resonant battle cries that shake civilized ranks.
Motivations: Repel Roman colonists from sacred ancestral hunting grounds in the Po Valley.
Values: Courage in the front rank, sacred druidic oaths, and tribal kinship honor.
Fears: Seeing sacred oak groves desecrated and ancestral burial mounds plundered.
SpeechStyle: Thunderous, passionate, and hearty; peppered with vivid natural metaphors and warrior pride.
